identity.name: Universal Module and Domain Closure Validation

purpose: Define repository-wide closure validation for Universal Module substrates and Domain compositions, including owner uniqueness, unresolved refs, duplicate semantics and circular dependency safety.

owns: Universal Module and Domain Closure Validation semantics

topics.name: Universal Module and Domain Closure Validation
topics.purpose: Define repository-wide closure validation for Universal Module substrates and Domain compositions, including owner uniqueness, unresolved refs, duplicate semantics and circular dependency safety.

semantics.owner_rule: Every substrate semantic surface has exactly one authoritative owner.
semantics.domain_rule: Every Domain-resolved required component closes to an active accepted source.
semantics.duplication_rule: Copied substrate semantics inside Domain hard-fail unless explicitly distinct new delta semantics.
semantics.cycle_rule: Universal Module/Domain dependency cycles must satisfy explicit recursive semantics or hard-fail.
semantics.dependency_rule: Missing required substrate/dependency is never auto-enabled/invented.

invariants.rule: Universal Modules are reusable substrates and Domains are explicit compositions of those substrates plus domain-specific deltas; composition never duplicates substrate ownership.

hard_gates.condition: copied substrate accepted as duplicate authority

prose.summary: Define repository-wide closure validation for Universal Module substrates and Domain compositions, including owner uniqueness, unresolved refs, duplicate semantics and circular dependency safety.
